activity_summary: Anne made the bargain plain. You will not promise a journey until it is arranged, and the only one arranged is the carrier on the eighteenth, at the horses' pace. She told you what cannot wait: you have not looked at a real house. She did not name one, and she named no price. You agreed to look when she shows you, and not to buy a house with your mouth from the floor.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Promised only the arranged road, and a look with no purchase in it.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Set both halves of the bargain, and withheld the name and the price.

facets.activity: Agreed to look at a house, and promised only the eighteenth

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: You will not promise me a journey until the journey is arranged.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not promise you another on the strength of being sorry I am on a floor.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Don't promise me a house, Will.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: No journey but the one that is set. No house from a floor.
